title: Smart Factory Future: July Industry 4.0 Digital Campaign
objective: Drive awareness and qualified leads for advanced manufacturing solutions during Singapore's school holidays (peak B2B decision-making window); position client as thought leader in Industry 4.0 adoption.
target_audience: Manufacturing plant managers, operations directors, procurement heads at mid-market industrial companies (50–500 employees); age 35–55, LinkedIn-active, seeking automation/efficiency solutions.
key_activities: LinkedIn + Google Ads multi-channel campaign targeting high-intent keywords ('manufacturing automation', 'Industry 4.0 solutions', 'factory digitalization')
3-part educational content series (infographics + short-form video) on automation ROI, sustainability benefits, and workforce upskilling
Retargeting campaign targeting website visitors + LinkedIn audience lookalikes
Weekly performance optimization and A/B testing on ad creative, copy, and targeting segments
kpis: 150 qualified leads (MQL) within 6 weeks at CAC ≤ S$85
3.5× ROAS on paid spend
1,200 LinkedIn impressions/week, 4% engagement rate
25 demo/consultation requests from campaign
zynth_services: Paid Ads (LinkedIn & Google)
Content Creation (3 educational videos + 6 infographics)
Social Media Management (weekly optimization & reporting)
SEO (keyword research & audience targeting refinement)
why_now: July school holidays = decision-makers have uninterrupted time for strategic reviews and procurement planning. Manufacturing firms lock in Q3 budgets during this window. High-intent search volume for automation solutions peaks as companies plan H2 capital expenditure.
deliverables: Campaign strategy + audience segmentation report (LinkedIn, Google, lookalike)
3 educational short-form videos (60–90s, YouTube + LinkedIn native)
6 carousel + static infographics (manufacturing ROI, case studies, process flows)
Weekly performance reports (leads, CAC, ROAS, CTR, conversion rates)
A/B test results & optimization recommendations

title: MakerHub Singapore 2026: Industry 4.0 Flagship Conference & Exhibition
objective: Host a 200-pax half-day Industry 4.0 conference + vendor exhibition showcasing manufacturing innovation, thought leadership, and networking; generate 50+ qualified leads and position client as the ecosystem hub.
target_audience: Manufacturing plant managers, operations/engineering directors, procurement teams, sustainability officers, technology integrators, system vendors; mid-market to enterprise (50–2,000 employees).
key_activities: Venue booking (150–200 pax capacity, +AV/staging for 2 speaker tracks) at Marina Bay hotel or Changi Business Park
Speaker recruitment (2 external industry experts + client C-suite keynote)
Vendor booth curation (6–8 complementary tech/consulting partners, pre-sold sponsorships)
Registration + lead-capture system (linked to CRM; real-time badge scanning)
Post-event follow-up (48h thank-you video, 1-week nurture email sequence, recorded talks repurposed to YouTube)
kpis: 200 confirmed attendees (80% actual on-day presence = 160 pax minimum)
50 qualified leads with recorded interest in follow-up demos
6–8 vendor partnerships locked (sponsorship/booth fees cover 35% of event cost)
4,000+ impressions on event promotion (LinkedIn, email, industry newsletters)
Event satisfaction score ≥ 4.2/5 (post-event survey)
zynth_services: Event Management (full run-of-show, vendor coordination, logistics, day-of execution)
Content Creation (event recap video, speaker clips, promotional content)
Social Media Management (pre-, during-, and post-event promotion)
PR & Media (industry newsletter placement, speaker bios, press release)
why_now: July = mid-year planning window. Manufacturers are evaluating H2 capital investments and partner ecosystems. School holidays reduce scheduling conflicts for senior executives. Industry 4.0 adoption urgency is high post-COVID supply-chain disruptions.
deliverables: Event strategy + speaker + vendor prospecting list
Venue + AV + catering agreements (150–200 pax, 4-hour format)
Event brand identity (logo, signage, badge design, programme)
Pre-event promotion pack (LinkedIn campaign, email sequence, 2 teaser videos)
Day-of event management (registration, audio/visual, speaker coordination, badge scanning)
1 professional event recap video (3–5 min, 4K)
4 key-moment clips (30–60s, social-ready)
Post-event report (attendance, leads captured, ROI, participant feedback)

title: School Holidays Activation: 'Young Engineers Challenge' Brand Sponsorship & Content Series
objective: Leverage July school holidays to position client brand as innovation leader; engage youth (14–18) and parents through an interactive STEM challenge, building brand affinity and generating organic content for future B2B campaigns.
target_audience: Secondary students (age 14–18) interested in engineering/STEM; parents (age 40–55) supporting STEM education; schools, STEM centers in Singapore; dormant social audience seeking value-add content.
key_activities: Co-sponsor a 2-day 'Young Engineers Challenge' (robotics/IoT/automation mini-hack) at a popular STEM venue (Science Centre Singapore, Nanyang Technological University, or local innovation hub)
Live streaming of competition (YouTube + TikTok) with real-time commentary + sponsor branding
Behind-the-scenes content capture (participant interviews, mentor coaching moments, award ceremony)
Post-event UGC campaign (#YoEngineersChallenge): encourage participants to share builds + reflections for reuse in B2B content
Influencer partnership (2–3 STEM/tech micro-influencers aged 20–30 as event hosts/judges)
kpis: 500+ event participants (students + family members)
100,000+ combined video views (YouTube + TikTok live + replays)
1,200+ UGC posts/mentions (hashtag tracking)
15,000+ reach on organic social media (no paid amplification)
3 qualified B2B leads from parent networks / corporate sponsorship interest
zynth_services: Event Management (sponsor coordination, logistics, day-of production)
Content Creation (live-stream production, behind-the-scenes video, 8+ short-form clips)
Social Media Management (UGC curation, hashtag strategy, weekly posting)
Influencer Marketing (2–3 micro-influencer partnerships as hosts/judges + content)
why_now: July school holidays = families seeking enrichment activities; STEM interest peaks during break periods. Summer is peak engagement season for youth audiences on TikTok/YouTube. Content created now serves as evergreen proof-of-innovation for B2B decision-makers reviewing vendors in Q3.
deliverables: Event sponsorship proposal + negotiation with venue partner
2 full days of on-site event production (AV, live streaming setup, photographer)
1 professional 5–7 min highlight video (4K, broadcast-quality)
8 short-form clips optimized for TikTok/Reels (30–60s, subtitled)
Live-stream setup (YouTube + TikTok simultaneous broadcast with branding overlay)
UGC campaign brief + influencer collaboration contracts (2–3 influencers)
Content calendar + social management (4 weeks post-event, daily posts featuring participant stories)
Post-activation report (reach, engagement, UGC volume, brand sentiment)

title: Rebranding for Resilience: Manufacturing Brand Refresh Campaign
objective: Modernize client's brand identity to reflect Industry 4.0 positioning and appeal to younger engineers/operators entering the workforce; roll out rebrand across digital + physical touchpoints with a coordinated July launch.
target_audience: Internal stakeholders (staff, management, board); external audiences (customers, partners, prospective talent in engineering/operations); B2B buyers evaluating manufacturing vendors.
key_activities: Brand audit + positioning workshop (internal research on perception gaps, competitive positioning)
Brand identity redesign (logo, color palette, typography, brand guidelines)
Website redesign and migration (landing pages, case studies, new brand color system)
Internal comms campaign (employee briefing videos, change-management emails, in-office signage)
External launch event (digital + optional small in-person reveal for key partners)
Paid social amplification (LinkedIn, Instagram, Google) to drive traffic and brand recall
kpis: Brand recall increase: 40% lift in pre- vs. post-rebrand awareness (via survey)
Website traffic: 25% increase month-on-month post-launch
Social impressions: 30,000+ across LinkedIn + Instagram in first 4 weeks
Employee engagement: 85% internal staff view rebrand materials within 2 weeks
5 media mentions / industry publication features highlighting rebrand
zynth_services: Branding (audit, positioning, logo + visual identity design, brand guidelines)
Content Creation (brand film 2–3 min, employee briefing videos, website case-study content)
Tech (website redesign + development, responsive build, brand-system integration)
Social Media Management (launch day promotion, 4-week amplification, community response)
PR & Media (press release, journalist outreach, industry feature placement)
why_now: July marks a natural mid-year reset. School holidays provide a low-distraction window for internal communications. Manufacturing industry is actively re-evaluating vendor partnerships for H2; a modernized brand captures attention during this decision window. Rebrand positions firm ahead of Q4 business development season.
deliverables: Brand audit report + competitive positioning analysis
Refreshed logo + color palette + typography system + brand guidelines (60-page PDF)
3 brand identity applications (mockups): packaging, vehicle wrap, office signage
1 brand positioning film (2–3 min, 4K, for website hero + LinkedIn)
2 employee briefing videos (Mandarin + English subtitles)
Redesigned website (5–8 core pages, mobile-responsive, accessibility-compliant)
Launch day creative pack (social graphics, email templates, press release)
4-week social media calendar + managed posting (LinkedIn, Instagram, company website)
Post-launch brand sentiment report (media mentions, social sentiment, awareness lift)

target_audience: Operations directors, plant managers, procurement heads, CFOs at manufacturing firms (50–500 employees) actively evaluating automation solutions; SG-based + regional buyers.
key_activities: Build interactive ROI calculator tool (web-based, 5-min completion, gated lead capture form)
Create 4-part educational email nurture sequence (post-calculator submission) with case studies + implementation guides
Paid campaign (LinkedIn, Google Search, Display) targeting calculator landing page
Organic reach amplification (blog posts, PDF downloadables, LinkedIn content series)
Sales enablement: provide client's team with lead-scoring + qualification playbook
kpis: 100 calculator completions (qualified leads with company + contact data captured)
35% conversion rate from landing page visitor → calculator user
18% CTR on paid ads (above industry benchmark of 1.5–3%)
25 SQLs (sales-qualified leads) after email nurture sequence
2.8× ROAS on paid spend (conservative target)
zynth_services: Tech (interactive calculator development, lead database integration, form optimization)
Content Creation (4-email sequence, 3 downloadable case-study PDFs, 2 blog articles)
Paid Ads (LinkedIn, Google Search, Display retargeting)
Social Media Management (organic promotion, LinkedIn sharing cadence)
Email Marketing (4-week nurture sequence, segmentation setup)

Landing page (dedicated, optimized for conversion, 3 variant tests)
4 email templates (nurture sequence, professional design, A/B test variants)
3 downloadable PDFs (case studies, implementation guide, ROI framework)
2 blog articles (SEO-optimized, 1,200+ words each, internal link strategy)
